crossRefs.note: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

translations.web: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,
translations.bsb: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hand and you take them captive,
translations.kjv: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies, and the LORD thy God hath delivered them into thine hands, and thou hast taken them captive,
translations.asv: When thou goest forth to battle against thine enemies, and Jehovah thy God delivereth them into thy hands, and thou carriest them away captive,
